meta.title: Walking and biking access by route, Colorado
meta.method: Each 2020 Census block with homes is joined to the nearest street. Distance to the nearest service is the shortest route on streets and trails. A block counts as within reach when that route is at most the limit. Shares are of homes (2020 Census housing units). Jobs reachable is the homes-weighted median, across the place's blocks, of LODES jobs on the network within the limit.
meta.off_network: A home or service more than 400 m from any street is off the network and never counts as within reach.
meta.reach_definition: walk_reach and bike_reach are the average, across grocery, school, health care and park, of the share of homes within a 10-minute walk or a 15-minute ride.
not_modelled: bike lanes outside the DRCOG region, Colorado Springs and Grand Junction
sidewalks outside the DRCOG region and Colorado Springs
meta.bike_closed: Freeway stretches CDOT maps as Bicycles Prohibited are out of every walking and biking measure: 1346 TIGER street pieces drawn along them (interstates themselves are already left out).
meta.bike_calm_definition: bike_calm_reach is bike_reach using only local streets (TIGER S1400 and smaller), trails and paths, plus state or US highways (S1200) with a mapped bike lane, separated lane, bike boulevard or path alongside. Shoulders and signed routes do not count. Outside the three bike inventories (bike_inventory) no S1200 counts, so it may understate where lanes exist but are not mapped.
meta.sidewalk_definition: Reported only where at least 80% of homes lie in 500 m grid cells the sidewalk inventory covers. sidewalk_pct is the share of street length (S1200 and S1400 pieces at least 30 m long) with a mapped sidewalk within 25 m along it. walk_sidewalk_reach is walk_reach using only streets with a sidewalk, walkways, trails and paths. missing_sidewalk_km is the length DRCOG marks Possible Missing Sidewalk.

fields.walk / bike: share of homes (%) within a 10-minute walk / 15-minute ride of each service, by street and trail
fields.walk_roads / bike_roads: the same on streets only, so the difference is what trails add
fields.walk_straight / bike_straight: the same by straight-line distance, for comparison
fields.jobs_walk15 / jobs_bike15: jobs reachable in a 15-minute walk / ride (homes-weighted median)
fields.epa_walk_index: EPA National Walkability Index (1 to 20), homes-weighted median of the 2010 block groups the place's homes fall in
fields.bike_calm / bike_calm_reach: share of homes within a 15-minute ride avoiding state and US highways without a bike lane or path
fields.walk_side / walk_sidewalk_reach: share of homes within a 10-minute walk on sidewalks, walkways, trails and paths (null where sidewalks are not mapped)
fields.sidewalk_mapped_homes_pct: share of homes inside the mapped sidewalk area
fields.sidewalk_source / bike_inventory: which local inventory covers the place: drcog, cos (Colorado Springs) or gj (Grand Junction)
fields.sidewalk_pct / street_km_mapped / missin: street length with a sidewalk (%), street length measured (km), DRCOG possible missing sidewalk (km)
fields.bike_facility_km: km of mapped bike lanes and local paths inside the town outline (local inventories only, not COTREX)
fields.blockGroups: by 2010 block group: [homes, walk_reach, bike_reach, transit_reach, jobs_walk15, jobs_bike15, walk % grocery, school, health, park, transit, bike % grocery, school, health, park, transit, bike_calm_reach, walk_sidewalk_reach]

bands.basis: Quartiles of the 316 Colorado towns with 200 or more homes. Strong: at or above the top-quarter cut. Fair: at or above the median. Limited: above the bottom-quarter cut. Very limited: at or below it.

sources.name: U.S. Census Bureau, TIGER/Line Shapefiles 2025, All Roads
Colorado Parks and Wildlife, Colorado Trail Explorer (COTREX) trails, September 2025 update
sources.kept: Trail and Interpretive Trail segments: 43037 open to walking, 35457 open to bikes.

sources.name: U.S. Census Bureau, TIGER/Line 2020 tabulation blocks (HOUSING20, 2020 Census housing units)
U.S. Census Bureau, LEHD LODES 8, workplace area characteristics, 2023, all jobs
U.S. Census Bureau, LODES 8 geography crosswalk (block to place)
CDOT Bicycling Map, CDOT Bike Paths
City of Colorado Springs, Bike Facilities
City of Grand Junction, Bike Routes
EPA Smart Location Database v3.0, National Walkability Index

grocery.kept: supermarket, grocery, greengrocer and general stores; convenience stores, fuel stations and wholesale clubs left out

school.kept: schools and kindergartens; colleges and universities left out

health.source: OpenStreetMap Overpass API (public); HRSA Health Center Service Delivery and Look-Alike Sites
health.kept: clinics, doctors, hospitals and pharmacies, plus HRSA community health center sites; dentists left out

transit.source: CDOT Statewide Transit Points (primary); agency GTFS feeds via the Mobility Database catalog; OpenStreetMap (unconfirmed)
transit.kept: confirmed fixed-route stops (CDOT or an agency feed); demand-response and OpenStreetMap-only stops left out. How often buses stop is not counted yet.

meta.odbl_notice: Grocery, school, health care and park locations contain information from OpenStreetMap, made available under the Open Database License.
